task.description:
Write test specs and test source files for ISS-601 and ISS-602 based on the design docs and implementation.

ISS-601 tests: benchmark test for NFR-04 (10k event replay < 5s), snapshot creation test, snapshot-based reconstruction test, overflow payload join test.

ISS-602 tests: differential harness test that validates CEL vs expr parity on the initial corpus, divergence catalog test.

Write specs to tests/specs/ISS-601.md and tests/specs/ISS-602.md. Write test source files to appropriate test layers.

No error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests. All fixtures use per-test UUIDs.

REWORK 1:
- [BLOCKER] TC-ISS-601-02 missing: No integration test for snapshot-based delta reconstruction (50 events, snapshot at seq 25, delta replay 26..50)
- [BLOCKER] TC-ISS-601-05 missing: No integration test for overflow payload join (event_payloads_overflow COALESCE)
- [MAJOR] TC-ISS-602-03 missing: No automated unit test for the cutover gate (regression prevention -- verify no production module imports src/expr/ on engine path)
- [MAJOR] TC-ISS-602-06 missing: No unit test for translateCelToExpr returning null on unsupported CEL features
- [MAJOR] ISS-601 NFR-04 snapshot-assisted benchmark missing: No 100k-event snapshot-assisted replay benchmark (<1s) exists
- [MINOR] TC-ISS-601-08 partial: Only interval arithmetic tested; full reconstruction path with 2500 events at 2 snapshot boundaries not tested

Add ALL missing tests above to the test source files. Then re-submit.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/ISS-601.md exists and covers all ISS-601 acceptance criteria
tests/specs/ISS-602.md exists and covers all ISS-602 acceptance criteria
Test source files written for both requirements
No error.SkipZigTest on any MUST test
All integration test fixtures use per-test UUIDs

result.summary: REWORK 1 complete. All 6 validator issues resolved. Added TC-ISS-601-02 (snapshot-based delta reconstruction with 50 events, snapshot at seq 25, delta replay 26..50), TC-ISS-601-05 (overflow payload join via event_payloads_overflow COALESCE), TC-ISS-601-08 full reconstruction path (2500 events at 2 snapshot boundaries seq 1000/2000), TC-ISS-602-03 (cutover gate regression test via @embedFile verifying no src/expr/ import in transition.zig), TC-ISS-602-06 (translateCelToExpr null on unsupported CEL features: macros, list comprehensions, maps, functions), ISS-601 NFR-04 100k-event snapshot-assisted replay benchmark (<1s target) in bench.zig.
